_about: Demo settings. The demo follows the calendar; add "today": "YYYY-MM-DD" to fix a date. The WasteDataFlow quarter follows it too (add "quarter" to override). collection_day_wards are wards where it is bin day today, so bags there are probably awaiting collection. bulky_bookings are booked bulky-waste collections; a photo within 30 m of one on its date is treated as not fly-tipping. The depot is a placeholder, not a real council site.
_audience: Phones in the room (through the tunnel). audience_access: on or off (off sends every phone a thank-you and stops them polling; scripts/room.sh off). audience_uploads: on or off (off closes reporting from the room). audience_ai: on or paused (paused holds their photos for the model; yours still go straight through). audience_gap_seconds: rest between their photos so this laptop stays usable. Saved changes apply at once.

bulky_bookings.address: Lawrence Road, Wavertree, Liverpool L15 (demo booking)
